# lab/: the aglab runner, provenance, run-directory writers, level generator.
# Layout follows NeonTide/lab/CMakeLists.txt (commit 3dc7266).
string(TOUPPER "${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}" _ag_bt)
string(REPLACE ";" " " _ag_num "${AG_NUMERIC_FLAGS}")
file(WRITE "${AG_GEN_DIR}/ag/BuildFlags.gen.h.tmp"
"#pragma once
// Generated by lab/CMakeLists.txt at configure time.
#define AG_BUILD_TYPE \"${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}\"
#define AG_CXX_FLAGS \"${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} ${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_${_ag_bt}} ${_ag_num} -std=c++20\"
")
file(COPY_FILE "${AG_GEN_DIR}/ag/BuildFlags.gen.h.tmp" "${AG_GEN_DIR}/ag/BuildFlags.gen.h" ONLY_IF_DIFFERENT)

add_library(ag_lab STATIC src/aglab.cpp src/app.cpp src/c_api.cpp src/framelog.cpp src/levelgen.cpp src/provenance.cpp
                          src/runio.cpp src/stepbench.cpp)
if(ANDROID)
  target_sources(ag_lab PRIVATE src/sysinfo_android.cpp)
elseif(APPLE)
  target_sources(ag_lab PRIVATE src/sysinfo_apple.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(ag_lab PUBLIC "-framework CoreFoundation" "-framework Foundation")
  if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "iOS")
    target_link_libraries(ag_lab PUBLIC "-framework IOKit")
  endif()
endif()
target_include_directories(ag_lab PUBLIC include PRIVATE src "${AG_GEN_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(ag_lab PUBLIC ag_core ag_gfx)
# Desktop default; the apps pass --kernels=<payload>/kernels.
target_compile_definitions(ag_lab PRIVATE AG_DEFAULT_KERNEL_DIR="${AG_KERNEL_DIR}")
add_dependencies(ag_lab ag_gitinfo)
ag_set_warnings(ag_lab)

if(AG_BUILD_CLI)
  add_executable(aglab src/main.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(aglab PRIVATE ag_lab)
  ag_set_warnings(aglab)
  set_target_properties(aglab PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}")
endif()
